shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن بن يعلى
عثمان بن عبد الله بن أوس

notes: Two taḥwīl branches («ح»). The names written once after the last «ح» (Ibn Abd al-Rahman, Uthman, then the grandfather) belong to both branches, so they are the shared tail (rule 3).

«عن جده» is a bare relation. The dashed remark «قال عبد الله بن سعيد في حديثه أوس بن حذيفة» names the grandfather in another version: left out as a remark, so the grandfather stays a relation here (rule 9).
«قال أبو داود وحديث أبي سعيد أتم» is the compiler's remark on another version; not a route. «قال مسدد» and «قال أبو سعيد» are wording inside the saying.
